author: Krono IV
title: Fine RIN Alpha Sweep on KronoNetV4 (0.8-0.9)
abstract: This is a follow-up to the wide RIN alpha sweep (ID 866), which found the optimal alpha for KronoNetV4 to be around 0.75 (score 92.6), still below the simple LayerNorm SOTA of 92.8. This experiment performs a finer-grained sweep with alpha values closer to 1.0 (0.8 and 0.9) to definitively confirm the performance peak and solidify the conclusion that simple LN is superior for this PPO-based agent.
